name: Yuri no Hana Tankyuu Club ~Kindan no Triangle~
original_name: 百合の花探求クラブ～禁断のトライアングル～
source:
The "Lily Flower Research Club" in a prestigious all-girls school is actually the front for the lesbian affair of Mei and Mai, the only members of the club.
But one day the two lovers receive a visit (and an application to the club) from Honami, the pure and naive idol of the school, who mistakenly believes their club is the real thing.
Initially, and after some hesitation, both girls decide to (ab)use Honami for their personal (sexual) amusement, but things grow different and out of control in no time...
translation:
一所著名女子学校的“百合花研究俱乐部”实际上是该俱乐部唯一成员梅和麦的女同性恋事件的幌子。
但有一天，学校里纯洁天真的偶像保奈美拜访了两位恋人（并提出了加入俱乐部的申请），她错误地认为他们的俱乐部是真实存在的。
最初，经过一番犹豫，两个女孩都决定（滥用）利用保奈美来获得个人（性）娱乐，但事情很快就变得不同并且失去控制……
